verses.text: Hear my prayer, Yahweh! Let my cry come to you.
lines: Hear my prayer, Yahweh!
Let my cry come to you.

verses.text: Don’t hide your face from me in the day of my distress. Turn your ear to me. Answer me quickly in the day when I call.
lines: Don’t hide your face from me in the day of my distress.
Turn your ear to me.
Answer me quickly in the day when I call.

verses.text: For my days consume away like smoke. My bones are burned as a torch.
lines: For my days consume away like smoke.
My bones are burned as a torch.

verses.text: My heart is blighted like grass, and withered, for I forget to eat my bread.
lines: My heart is blighted like grass, and withered,
for I forget to eat my bread.

verses.text: By reason of the voice of my groaning, my bones stick to my skin.
lines: By reason of the voice of my groaning,
my bones stick to my skin.

verses.text: I am like a pelican of the wilderness. I have become as an owl of the waste places.
lines: I am like a pelican of the wilderness.
I have become as an owl of the waste places.

verses.text: I watch, and have become like a sparrow that is alone on the housetop.
lines: I watch, and have become like a sparrow that is alone on the housetop.

verses.text: My enemies reproach me all day. Those who are mad at me use my name as a curse.
lines: My enemies reproach me all day.
Those who are mad at me use my name as a curse.

verses.text: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mixed my drink with tears,
lines: For I have eaten ashes like bread,
and mixed my drink with tears,

verses.text: because of your indignation and your wrath; for you have taken me up and thrown me away.
lines: because of your indignation and your wrath;
for you have taken me up and thrown me away.

verses.text: My days are like a long shadow. I have withered like grass.
lines: My days are like a long shadow.
I have withered like grass.

verses.text: But you, Yahweh, will remain forever; your renown endures to all generations.
lines: But you, Yahweh, will remain forever;
your renown endures to all generations.

verses.text: You will arise and have mercy on Zion; for it is time to have pity on her. Yes, the set time has come.
lines: You will arise and have mercy on Zion;
for it is time to have pity on her.
Yes, the set time has come.

verses.text: For your servants take pleasure in her stones, and have pity on her dust.
lines: For your servants take pleasure in her stones,
and have pity on her dust.

verses.text: So the nations will fear Yahweh’s name, all the kings of the earth your glory.
lines: So the nations will fear Yahweh’s name,
all the kings of the earth your glory.

verses.text: For Yahweh has built up Zion. He has appeared in his glory.
lines: For Yahweh has built up Zion.
He has appeared in his glory.

verses.text: He has responded to the prayer of the destitute, and has not despised their prayer.
lines: He has responded to the prayer of the destitute,
and has not despised their prayer.

verses.text: This will be written for the generation to come. A people which will be created will praise Yah.
lines: This will be written for the generation to come.
A people which will be created will praise Yah.

verses.text: For he has looked down from the height of his sanctuary. From heaven, Yahweh saw the earth;
lines: For he has looked down from the height of his sanctuary.
From heaven, Yahweh saw the earth;

verses.text: to hear the groans of the prisoner; to free those who are condemned to death;
lines: to hear the groans of the prisoner;
to free those who are condemned to death;

verses.text: that men may declare Yahweh’s name in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem;
lines: that men may declare Yahweh’s name in Zion,
and his praise in Jerusalem;

verses.text: when the peoples are gathered together, the kingdoms, to serve Yahweh.
lines: when the peoples are gathered together,
the kingdoms, to serve Yahweh.

verses.text: He weakened my strength along the course. He shortened my days.
lines: He weakened my strength along the course.
He shortened my days.

verses.text: I said, “My God, don’t take me away in the middle of my days. Your years are throughout all generations.
lines: I said, “My God, don’t take me away in the middle of my days.
Your years are throughout all generations.

verses.text: Of old, you laid the foundation of the earth. The heavens are the work of your hands.
lines: Of old, you laid the foundation of the earth.
The heavens are the work of your hands.

verses.text: They will perish, but you will endure. Yes, all of them will wear out like a garment. You will change them like a cloak, and they will be changed.
lines: They will perish, but you will endure.
Yes, all of them will wear out like a garment.
You will change them like a cloak, and they will be changed.

verses.text: But you are the same. Your years will have no end.
lines: But you are the same.
Your years will have no end.

verses.text: The children of your servants will continue. Their offspring will be established before you.”
lines: The children of your servants will continue.
Their offspring will be established before you.”
